# Hamburg GAA

> Hamburg GAA is a Gaelic Athletic Association (GAA) club based in Hamburg, Germany, promoting Irish sports including Hurling, Camogie, and Gaelic Football.

## About

Hamburg GAA is a sports club in Hamburg, Germany, that brings together a diverse international community through traditional Irish sports. The club competes in European GAA competitions and welcomes players of all levels, from complete beginners to experienced players.

## Sports

- Hurling
- Camogie
- Gaelic Football

## Languages

The website is available in English and German (Deutsch).

- English: https://www.hamburggaa.de/en
- Deutsch: https://www.hamburggaa.de/de
